title: Services foundation: token block, theme contract and ledger of what is built
detail: Plan step 3 and the token half of step 5. Done in this row: SERVICES_TOKENS_CSS and SERVICES_DAY_CSS (lib/theme/services.ts, every name --sv-*, compared value for value by the intake), themes.Services in theme-contract.json (Night root, day{}, six accents). Deviation written down: the handoff's contract file says --th-on-accent #FFFFFF but its README, plan and tokens say ink; white on Tide is under 3:1, so the contract carries ink #0B0F13. Fonts load with the chrome (LIVE-1992) through next/font. Theme fence: tokens are scoped to [data-house-theme="services"] and only the stand-alone site render emits them.
